rule version fits SAP field RULE_VER (CHAR 12)
only HTSP is an inference (basis I)
sil/tasks.py is identical to edge/tasks.py
mapping: heat Severe, RH 60%: fans, then pads, then pad check
mapping: heat Severe, RH 80%: pads withheld
mapping: heat Moderate + low air speed: fans, then fan belts and the inlet opening
mapping: brooding cold Severe: heaters first, then chick behaviour (v2)
mapping: brooding cold Moderate: chick behaviour, then heaters (v2)
mapping: heat Severe + low air speed: fans, pads, then the fan belts before the pad pump (v2)
mapping: heat Severe, RH 80% + low air speed: pads withheld, airflow checks
mapping: brooding hot Severe: checks before lowering the set point
mapping: brooding, T missing: checks common to cold and hot
mapping: NH3 Severe first, then the first task of thermal Moderate (breadth-first)
mapping: NH3+CO2 Moderate tie: each indicator's first task before any second task
mapping: brooding hot + CO2 Severe tie: chick behaviour, air quality, then ventilation check
mapping: other indicator capped at the persisted level, cause first
mapping: Normal: no task
possible cause: heat, RH 60%: cooling stage below the load
possible cause: heat, RH 80%: humid heat
possible cause: heat, RH 75.0% is not humid heat (pad limit)
possible cause: heat + low air speed: low airflow
possible cause: brooding cold: heaters or cold air
possible cause: brooding hot: set point or heat above target
possible cause: brooding, T missing: no possible cause
possible cause: NH3, RH 70%: wet litter
possible cause: NH3, RH 69.9%: litter condition
possible cause: CO2: ventilation below need
possible cause: NH3+CO2 tie: the first cause indicator (NH3)
possible cause: Normal: none
possible causes: codes <= 4 chars, texts <= 40 chars, every cause has a source
pad guard: RH 75.0% allowed, 75.1% withheld
pad guard: T 28.0 C withheld, 28.1 C allowed
pad guard: week 3 (day 14) withheld, week 4 allowed

grid (1,296 cases): <= 3 distinct catalog tasks; tasks iff Moderate/Severe; no fan/pad task before day 21; first task from the most severe indicator; possible cause iff Moderate/Severe and consistent with the tasks (no pads in humid heat, fan-belt check with low airflow)
pipeline: no task while persistence holds the level at Normal, tasks once Severe
pipeline: assessment carries rule version and survives JSON

local alert text names the source of each task
pipeline: assessment carries the possible cause and the task mode (preventive / corrective)
